name: Right Model, Effort & Prompt
tagline: Picks a suitable AI model and effort level, then tightens your prompt
description: Describe a task and it names a model and effort setting to suit it across OpenAI, Anthropic, Grok, Meta, and Google, so premium capacity stops going to work a cheaper model handles. It reworks your prompt too, before you ever hit send, and weekday mornings bring a note when fresh model news changes its pick.
author: Foundation_Bots
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
